title: ADR Common Frontmatter Schema
description: Shared frontmatter structure for all ADR types (STE-compliant, PRIME-1, PRIME-2)

adr_type.description: Type of ADR (logical, physical, or decision)

authors.description: List of ADR authors (e.g., github handles, email)

domains.description: Architectural domains this ADR belongs to (for discovery and graph queries)

related_adrs.description: Related ADRs (bidirectional association edges in graph)

supersedes.description: ADRs that this ADR supersedes (evolution edges)

superseded_by.description: ADR that supersedes this one (null if current)

architecture_authority.description: Team or individual responsible for architectural decisions

implementation_owners.description: Teams responsible for implementing this ADR

ownership.description: Ownership metadata for governance and escalation

projection_signals.description: Context signals that activate rules derived from this ADR. Consumed by ste-rules-library for rule projection. Examples: python, scope-resolution, traceability, security

minimal_sections.description: Section names for minimal AI context (e.g., invariants, decisions)

primary_domains.description: Primary domains for AI projection priority

ai_projectable.description: AI-first projection hints for ste-rules-library and prompt translator
